findings.rationale: Missing values appear to be exported as a sentinel code rather than as missing. BMI has a near-zero lower tail (p01 about 0.2) and an inflated SD (about 13.8, versus a federation median of about 6.4). PhysHlth has a p99 near 72 against a median near 30, which is consistent with a 99 sentinel. The client also has the lowest mean update cosine in the federation (0.129), consistent with training on corrupted data. The anomaly is confirmed by a narrower query at round 20. Onset could not be pinned down with the remaining budget, so onset is set to round 1 (sentinel coding is typically present from the start).

Same sentinel pattern as MT. BMI has a p01 of about 0.003 and an SD of about 13.0 (median SD about 6.4). PhysHlth has a p99 near 73, far above the federation median of about 30. The z_noise values are around -12.6 for BMI and 25.2 for PhysHlth. The narrow round-20 query confirms the pattern. Onset is set to round 1 because the cause is an export artefact and could not be dated with the remaining budget.

Same sentinel pattern. BMI has a p01 of about 0.02 and an SD of about 13.3, and PhysHlth has a p99 near 73. The z_noise values are about -11.6 for BMI and 25.1 for PhysHlth. SC also has one of the lowest mean update cosines (0.088) and a negative min cosine (-0.53), consistent with corrupted local data. The narrow round-20 query confirms the pattern. Onset is set to round 1 for the same reason as MT and NJ.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with client_updates, client_performance, drift_by_round, feature_summary and subgroup_outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income), then confirmed leads with narrower queries. Three clients (MT, NJ, SC) show a consistent missing_artefact pattern: BMI has a near-zero lower tail with inflated spread, and PhysHlth has a ~72-73 upper tail, consistent with sentinel codes. Their z_noise values are around 12-25 and the narrow query confirmed them. Onset is not determinable with the budget spent, so round 1 is reported. No client showed anomalous update norms or directions (no poisoning, free-rider or explanation-instability signal), and local AUC/CITL showed no label-noise or prevalence-shift pattern beyond GU (small n, citl z=-3.6, not confirmed). Subgroup outliers (CT/PR/WY AgeGroup 5, TX/NH Income) show observed above expected, not under-diagnosis, and are small-cell noise. Drift leads (DC, GU, VI, DE) were not consistent across rounds. CT's GenHlth tail flag disappeared on confirmation. The budget is fully spent (0 left).
